survival-contract.profession.MUSICIAN.de:

Play 3 different tones within 5s: all allies gain a random 15s positive effect (drawn from the tones played)
Bass drum/iron xylophone/trumpet tones: all creatures within 32 blocks except yourself take 2 true damage and are slightly knocked back (once every 3s)
Hand drum (unlocked by the Into Fire advancement): hold a note block in the main hand and any block in the off hand — right-click air or a note block to play the tone matching that block (same as the stick, including the sonic attack and ensemble bonus)
Immune to negative status effects (except Wither)

Immune to score loss from being killed by hostile mobs

survival-contract.msg.stowaway.intro1: §bYou received the «§6Value Bag§b» (brown bundle) and the «§cBribe Bag§b» (red bundle): the Value Bag holds goods (may be confiscated on inspection), the Bribe Bag holds bribes (never confiscated).
survival-contract.msg.stowaway.intro2: §bThe screen shows three public goods for your group (random value 2/4/8) plus one contraband visible only to you (fixed 128 pts); the set is replaced every 10 minutes.
survival-contract.msg.stowaway.intro3: §bPut goods into the Value Bag: if an inspection passes (bribe / no contraband), the bag is cleared and converted into the corresponding points.
survival-contract.msg.stowaway.intro4: §bRight-click the «Inspection Request» to pick a non-friendly player as your prosecutor: after a 3-second countdown you enter the inspection room (you on the red carpet, they on the blue carpet; neither can move once inside), and after seeing your bribe bag total they decide within 2 minutes — accepting the bribe means they take the bribe bag and your cargo bag is cleared and converted; inspecting means if you have no contraband they pay you 1/4 of the cargo value (the bag converts too), and if you have contraband all your goods are confiscated (the bribe bag is unaffected); on timeout it defaults to accepting the bribe; when it ends both return to their spots!
survival-contract.msg.stowaway.no_goal: §bNo final goal this round: put goods into the Value Bag; when an inspection passes it clears and converts to points — the first team/player to reach (participants × 300) points wins instantly; otherwise the highest score when time runs out wins!
